fit_reason: Although listed as a private seller, this reads as dealer stock: the trunk carries a Dahl Automotive dealer badge, the text offers payment options, warranty and trades, and the photos are staged in a lot with another dealer vehicle in the background.
findings: Paint on the hood, doors and rear quarters is glossy with clean, sharp reflections
Wheels and tires look clean and dressed
No visible grime, water spots or faded trim in any of the exterior photos
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2022 Corolla. The paint on the hood and doors already looks glossy and well kept. If you ever need a mobile detail or a light buff on other cars you're selling, we come to you. Would you like a quote?
